newsitem.title: CHINA: China-Russia trade soars along northeast border.
newsitem.headline: China-Russia trade soars along northeast border.

text.p: Border trade between Russia and China's northeastern Heilongjiang province soared 133 percent year-on-year between January and April to $220 million, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Exports were worth $49.46 million in the first four months of 1997, double the amount in the same period last year.
Light industrial exports of garments and food accounted for 32.5 percent of the total. Exports of local products and grain also increased, and plums accounted for 39 percent of imports.
The province sent 3,546 workers to Russia, twice the number in the same period of 1996 and signed 67 cooperative projects, 24 percent higher than the same period of 1996, Xinhua said.
